d.ko: In Torchlight III, Novastraia is again under threat of invasion and it’s up to you to defend against the Netherim and its allies. Gather your wits and brave the frontier to find fame, glory, and new adventures!
d.en: In Torchlight III, Novastraia is again under threat of invasion and it’s up to you to defend against the Netherim and its allies. Gather your wits and brave the frontier to find fame, glory, and new adventures!
d.zh: 《火炬之光 2》的事件已经过去了一个世纪，烬石帝国进入衰退期。在《火炬之光 3》中，诺瓦特拉亚再一次陷入遭到侵略的危机之中，你必须挺身而出抵挡冥裔和它们的帮凶。打起十二分精神，勇敢地在前线中战斗，赢取声望、荣誉，并体验新的冒险！
